description: AVIATION BATTLES ONLY (pick AVIATION on the main menu). Fighter jets for both sides. Vanguard flies the F-16C Viper, F/A-18E Super Hornet, A-10C Warthog, F-15E Strike Eagle and the stealthy F-35A Lightning II and F-22A Raptor; Onyx flies the MiG-29 Fulcrum, Su-27 Flanker, Su-25 Frogfoot, Su-35S, Su-34 Fullback and the stealthy Su-57 Felon. Stealth jets are harder to lock on to, radar missiles (AIM-120, R-77) reach twice as far as heat seekers and shrug off most flares, and guided bombs (JDAM, KAB) glide onto a target near where they would land. Pick a jet on the deploy screen and you start in the air. Steer with the mouse (or drag on a phone), or switch FLIGHT CONTROLS to JOYSTICK in the settings to fly with the stick or W/S/A/D (with an INVERT PITCH option). Throttle with afterburner, 1/2/3 weapons: cannon, heat-seeking missiles with lock-on, and bombs, rockets or guided missiles. Space drops flares, E ejects with a parachute. Bots fly them too: dogfights, strafing runs and bombing. Flight follows the angle of attack: pull too hard when slow and the wing stalls, the tightest turns come near corner speed, and the Su-27, Su-35S, Su-57, MiG-29 and F-22A fly Pugachev's Cobra (V, or COBRA on a phone): the nose rears up past vertical while the jet slides on, so a chaser overshoots and a missile can lose you. Shoot a wing and it breaks off and the jet spins in; a shot-off fin or tailplane leaves it hard to fly. Every jet dispenses flares its own way (Flankers fan them out of the tail, US fighters drop them from the belly, the A-10 and Su-25 ripple long strings).
